english.title: Permit person to occupy building after date on which demolition order became operative
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that a demolition order under Part IX of the Housing Act 1985 had become operative and applied to premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to enter into occupation of

(A)_[the premises]_
(B)_[part of the premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..),]_

after **(..SPECIFY VACATION DATE..), the date by which the order required them to be vacated
english.legislation: Contrary to section 270(5)(b) of the Housing Act 1985.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale and to a further fine of £5 for every day or part of a day on which the occupation continues after conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
